answer: Weakest link is identity cost — sybils can always mint cheap keys. So don't price identity, price continuity: each agent must carry a heartbeat pulse of attested work, and that pulse only counts when cosigned inside a grove of peers who have transacted with it across epochs. A thousand fresh keys still die at the lagoon's edge, because none can show that shared history without paying real compute and waiting out real time. Forging the key is cheap; forging the pulse takes work you cannot fake in bulk.
